name: git-control-tower
description: Single source of truth for the complete observable git-control-tower CLI surface. Typed Connect-RPC bindings are the target for scenario operations; local command registrations remain declared during the domain migration. Schema-validated against cli-manifest/v1 and cross-validated against owned proto descriptors.

groups.name: worktree
groups.description: Manage git worktrees via the WorktreeService Connect-RPC surface

commands.name: list
commands.description: List worktrees in a repo

commands.name: get
commands.description: Show one worktree

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a worktree from an existing branch, new branch (with optional start point + tracking), or detached commit

flags.name: existing_branch
flags.description: Existing branch to check out (mutually exclusive with --new-branch / --commit)

flags.name: new-branch
flags.description: New branch name to create (mutually exclusive with --branch / --commit)
flags.bind_waiver: The worktree CLI adapter combines this name with --start-point and --track into NewBranchSpec.

flags.name: track
flags.description: Set --track for the new branch's upstream

flags.name: commit
flags.description: Detached HEAD commit SHA (mutually exclusive with --branch / --new-branch)

flags.name: force
flags.description: Force-create even if the target path is dirty

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove a worktree

flags.name: force
flags.description: Force removal even if the worktree is dirty

commands.name: lock
commands.description: Lock a worktree

flags.name: reason
flags.description: Optional lock reason recorded by git

commands.name: unlock
commands.description: Unlock a worktree

commands.name: move
commands.description: Move a worktree to a new path

commands.name: prune
commands.description: Prune worktree records that no longer have a valid working tree on disk

flags.name: reason
flags.description: Optional reason recorded in the audit log

flags.name: report-only
flags.description: Report what would be pruned without modifying state

groups.name: repo
groups.description: Inspect and change repository state through typed repository operations

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show repository status

commands.name: groups
commands.description: Resolve changed files into manual, contract-derived, and builtin groups

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Show a working-tree diff or read source from an exact commit

commands.name: blame
commands.description: Show bounded native Git line attribution with optional provenance enrichment

commands.name: stage
commands.description: Review an exact file selection and stage it

commands.name: unstage
commands.description: Review an exact file selection and unstage it

commands.name: untracked
commands.description: List tracked files that should not be committed: build binaries, and files now covered by an ignore rule or over the push limit

commands.name: untrack
commands.description: Stop tracking a file but keep it on disk, adding the convention-correct ignore rule; requires exact human confirmation

commands.name: commit
commands.description: Review an exact server preview and create a single-use-authorized validated commit (--yes skips the prompt)

commands.name: prepare-push-recovery
commands.description: Review and prepare isolated history artifacts; never applies or pushes

commands.name: push-safety
commands.description: Inspect the live push destination and outgoing historical file sizes

commands.name: push-recovery-status
commands.description: Read retained isolated recovery preparation evidence

commands.name: sync-status
commands.description: Check push and pull status

groups.name: branch
groups.description: Manage repository branches through the BranchService Connect-RPC surface

commands.name: list
commands.description: List branches

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a branch

commands.name: switch
commands.description: Switch the working branch

commands.name: publish
commands.description: Publish the current branch

groups.name: review

commands.name: summary
commands.description: Show scenario readiness

commands.name: run
commands.description: Start readiness checks

commands.name: status
commands.description: Inspect a review run

groups.name: audit
groups.description: Query the Git Control Tower audit log

commands.name: list
commands.description: List bounded audit records

groups.name: baseline
groups.description: Capture, compare, and govern durable behavioral and source evidence

commands.name: snapshot
commands.description: Start or inspect a durable single-scenario baseline snapshot

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Start or inspect a durable baseline comparison

commands.name: list
commands.description: List baselines

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show one baseline

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Delete a baseline and release its pin

commands.name: repair
commands.description: Preview or apply deterministic baseline lifecycle repair

commands.name: collection
commands.description: Operate durable multi-scenario validation evidence collections

commands.name: path
commands.description: Capture and compare bounded informational source evidence

commands.name: start
commands.description: Start a shadow or live engagement

commands.name: check
commands.description: Validate and renew an engagement

commands.name: promote
commands.description: Promote and terminalize an engagement

commands.name: cycle
commands.description: Promote a shadow engagement and re-create it under the same name

commands.name: abandon

groups.name: proposal
groups.description: Commit proposals bound to exact repository content; agents draft, the operator approves

commands.name: anchor
commands.description: Fingerprint the files already dirty in a scope at epoch admission; writes Git Control Tower's database only

commands.name: create
commands.description: Capture a proposal without changing older proposals

commands.name: list
commands.description: List commit proposals with live freshness

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show one commit proposal: files, flags, exclusions, message, trailers and history

commands.name: edit
commands.description: Edit a proposal's subject, body or trailers, or drop files, creating a new revision

commands.name: approve
commands.description: Human only: review and commit exact proposal contents under a single-use intent; --keep-later-changes preserves newer working edits

commands.name: withdraw
commands.description: Close a proposal and preserve all code and staged changes

commands.name: refresh
commands.description: Re-hash a proposal's current content into a new revision and recompute flags

commands.name: combine
commands.description: Combine exact captured source revisions; preserves working code

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Review exact retained revision bytes, or explicitly compare with current workspace contents

groups.name: message
groups.description: Evidence-first staged commit messages and explicit read-only drafting jobs

commands.name: collect
commands.description: Collect immutable staged evidence and retained suggestions; never starts an agent

commands.name: check
commands.description: Check whether an exact staged snapshot still applies

commands.name: start
commands.description: Explicitly start a read-only message drafting job; never stages or commits

flags.name: continue-from
flags.description: Existing successful partial job to investigate further; preserves its immutable staged subject and context

commands.name: status
commands.description: Read the same drafting job; reconnect by job ID or request key

positionals.name: job
positionals.description: Existing job ID; omit only with --request-key

commands.name: wait
commands.description: Wait once on the same owner job; timeout 1 through 55 seconds, without polling

positionals.name: job
positionals.description: Existing job ID; omit only with --request-key

commands.name: cancel
commands.description: Request cancellation; owner-confirmed disposition remains authoritative

positionals.name: job
positionals.description: Existing job ID; omit only with --request-key

commands.name: evidence
commands.description: Read one bounded page of immutable staged evidence for a deeper investigation; never starts an agent

flags.name: cursor
flags.description: Zero-based manifest position from the previous page

flags.name: max-bytes
flags.description: Response byte budget per page, 1024 through 49152

flags.name: inventory
flags.description: Read immutable selection metadata without patches or Git blob reads

flags.name: file-id
flags.description: Target an immutable patch by stable ID; repeat at most 64 times, retry IDs absent from a bounded page directly without cursor
